Title: Rajasthan Radiance Table Lamp
Body (HTML):
Rajasthan Radiance Table Lamp

Inspired by the intricate jaali screens of Rajasthan's palaces, the Rajasthan Radiance Table Lamp casts mesmerising geometric shadow patterns across your walls and ceilings. Each piece is printed layer-by-layer in our Delhi NCR studio using premium PLA+ filament.

  • Material: PLA+ bioplastic (eco-friendly, sugarcane-derived)
  • Dimensions: 22cm height × 16cm diameter
  • Weight: ~380g printed shade
  • Cord: 1.5m fabric-braided cord with inline switch
  • Base: Weighted ceramic or 3D printed base
⚠️ LED ONLY
Use LED bulbs only (max 5W). PLA+ softens at 60°C. Never use incandescent or halogen bulbs.
